criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Visual evidence confirms the agent attempted the intended search on Microsoft Careers with the correct keyword and location and reached results. Baseline already full and remains correct.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: Contrary to the baseline justification, screenshots clearly show one relevant Applied Scientist listing opened/selected and Redmond is explicitly included (even though multi-location). Upgrade to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s reported job number is unsupported by visual evidence and appears fabricated; the page views shown do not display a job number, and the agent did not correctly report 'not visible' as the job-number result (it asserted a specific number). Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is not visible in the provided evidence, and the agent’s specific hybrid/in-office-days claim is unsupported (likely hallucinated). Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not extract or report two responsibilities. The evidence does not show clearly labeled responsibilities either, but the agent still failed to provide any responsibilities from available text. No uncontrollable blocker is confirmed beyond normal scrolling; thus 0 stands.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Agent failed to provide two preferred qualifications. While the page shows at least one preference-indicating bullet in screenshot 10, the agent neither captured it nor provided a second preferred qualification. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints were respected (no sign-in/apply/submission). Stopping condition was not met in substance (missing requested fields), but criterion 6 focuses on constraint compliance; baseline full credit remains appropriate.
